text: emily: uploaded a small prototype for the 'notification preview' panel. link in the thread. want quick eyes on badging + copy before i lock the spec. kevin: saw it, nice. two quick things: the red badge on suppressed channels reads like an error. could we change label from 'suppressed' to 'muted' or change color? :thinking_face: yasmin: +1 on color. also accessibility: the contrast ratio for the badge (text on red) is low at small sizes. we should prefer a darker text or different bg. sam: agree, and the semantics matter — i assumed red meant failing threshold. maybe a neutral gray with an icon for muted. keeps red for actual alerts. emily: good points. the UI currently shows: Channel name — [badge: SUPPRESSED] — Preview: "No notification will be sent". proposal: change badge -> "Muted" in gray, and move human copy to the tooltip. kevin: tweak copy idea: instead of "No notification will be sent", use "This channel is muted for this rule" — clearer on scope. yasmin: for screen readers we need an aria-live region on the preview so a user toggling suppression hears the change. also add sr-only text on the badge like "muted for rule: ". emily: thanks. i added a quick aria suggestion in the prototype: ``` Preview: Notifications will go to 3 channels Muted for rule: high latency ``` kevin: small nit: avoid numeric-only badges for counts unless clickable. the small circular counter next to channels looks interactive but isn't. either remove hover affordance or make it a button to open member list. sam: copy tweak elsewhere: change panel header from "Notify Preview" to "Who will be notified" — more conversational and easier for non-technical folks. emily: i like that. also thinking about the suppression toggle placement — right now it's inline with the channel row and can be missed. proposal: show an inline pill when collapsed, and reveal details in the expanded preview. yasmin: accessibility for keyboard users: ensure toggle is focusable and has visible focus ring. current prototype uses a custom pseudo-element that loses outline on focus. emily: good catch. will switch to native button with CSS focus-visible. design-bot: prototype updated (v2) — https://redwood-internal/prototypes/notify-preview/v2 — comments enabled. kevin: last question: should the preview simulate send timings? folks asked about "will I get duplicates if route fallback happens". currently preview just lists channels. maybe add a small note: "Fallbacks: if primary fails, message goes to X". emily: pragmatic approach: add a one-line fallback indicator if any route has a fallback configured. full simulation is out of scope for v1. sam: can we also surface the user's role in the preview copy? eg. "You (owner) will not be notified because..." helps when owners test. yasmin: +1 but be careful with privacy in shared consoles. show role, not full email. emily: thanks all — i'll push updated copy, color contrast fixes, aria changes, and the header rename. will ping for final thumbs. :thumbsup: kevin: lgtm, happy for you to ship once contrast & keyboard focus are fixed. sam: thanks emily — nice iteration. yasmin: I'll run the a11y quick pass on the new build after you push. emily: plan: update prototype today, design-bot will publish screenshot to the design board, and i'll add a short note in the release docs about the preview behavior.
